fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说说借钱。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about borrowing money.
Do you like lending money to others?

fullTextZH: 或者，你喜欢找别人借钱？
fullTextEN: Or do you like borrowing money from others?

fullTextZH: 对，今天我要说一个借钱的故事。
fullTextEN: Yes, today I want to tell a story about borrowing money.
In the past, I had a good friend,
I liked him very, very much.
I thought he was very cute,
and he was also very nice to me.
He asked me to lend him money,
borrowed twice,
each time it was 50 dollars.
It wasn't a lot of money,
very little.

fullTextZH: 可是，我还是觉得他应该还给我。
fullTextEN: But I still think he should pay me back.

fullTextZH: 我觉得，如果我请你吃饭是请你吃饭，
fullTextEN: I think if I treat you to a meal, it's treating you to a meal,

fullTextZH: 如果我借钱给你是借钱给你，
fullTextEN: if I lend you money, it's lending you money,
these are different,
they should be separate, right.

fullTextZH: 所以，如果一个人找我借钱，
fullTextEN: So, if someone asks me to lend them money,
they must pay it back,
No matter how much,
he must repay it.
In China, we like to say,
"If you borrow and repay, borrowing again is not hard."
What does it mean?
It means,
if you borrow money,
then you repay the money,
then borrowing money again won't be difficult.
If someone asks me to borrow money,
and then he quickly repays it,
I can trust him, right.
I can trust him,
then I might lend to him again.

fullTextZH: 对，所以我的好朋友第一次借了50刀，
fullTextEN: Right, so my good friend borrowed 50 dollars the first time,
then I forgot, right.
He also forgot,

fullTextZH: 很久很久以后，我想起来了，
fullTextEN: a long time later, I remembered,
then I told him,
so he repaid me.
The first time, I felt, uh,
Maybe he really forgot,
because I also forgot.

fullTextZH: 所以，第二次他找我借钱，
fullTextEN: So, the second time he asked me to lend him money,
I still lent it to him.

fullTextZH: 然后，当然，他可能又忘了，
fullTextEN: Then, of course, maybe he forgot again,
but I did not forget.

fullTextZH: 我问他：“你什么时候还钱给我？”
fullTextEN: I asked him, "When will you pay me back?"
He said, "Um,

fullTextZH: 其实他给我转钱（transfer money）了，
fullTextEN: actually, he transferred the money to me,
but he transferred it wrong,
yes, he transferred it to someone else."
Do you think I believe him?
Of course not, I don't believe him.

fullTextZH: 我知道，有时候他可能会撒谎（to lie），对。
fullTextEN: I know, sometimes he might lie, yes.

fullTextZH: 所以，我知道他对我撒谎，
fullTextEN: So, I know he lied to me,
I don't believe him.
Because of this matter,
I feel, um,
I cannot trust him.

fullTextZH: 所以，以后我不要借钱给他，对。
fullTextEN: So, in the future, I shouldn't lend him money, right?

fullTextZH: 可是，我不知道怎么告诉他啊，
fullTextEN: But, I don't know how to tell him,
"I don't want to lend you money."
Then, I asked my other friends,
I said: "What should I do?
If he wants to borrow money in the future,
how should I say it?
I don't want to lend you money."
I said: "Hmm, do you think,

fullTextZH: 我可以不可以说，嗯，对不起，我没有钱？”
fullTextEN: can I say, hmm, sorry, I don't have money?"
My friend said: "No, no, no,
you shouldn't say you don't have money,
you just need to say,
'Sorry, I can't lend you money.'"

fullTextZH: 我觉得我的朋友说的对，
fullTextEN: I think my friend is right,
"I can't lend you money,"

fullTextZH: 我不需要告诉你为什么，
fullTextEN: I don't need to tell you why,

fullTextZH: 而且你应该知道为什么。
fullTextEN: and you should know why.
Right, so,
Ah, I think lending money,

fullTextZH: 借钱真的是一个很复杂（complicated）的问题。
fullTextEN: Borrowing money is indeed a very complicated issue.

fullTextZH: 如果是我的好朋友需要，
fullTextEN: If my good friend needs it,
I will definitely help them,

fullTextZH: 可是，如果一个人借钱可是没有还给我，
fullTextEN: But, if someone borrows money but doesn't return it to me,
Ah,
Ah,

fullTextZH: 可能会觉得很头疼（headache），怎么办？
fullTextEN: I might feel very troubled, what to do?
What should I say?

fullTextZH: 你呢？你有没有借钱的故事？
fullTextEN: What about you? Do you have any stories about borrowing money?
If someone borrows money and doesn't return it,
Would you still be friends with them?
Leave a comment to tell me.
Okay, thank you.
See you next time, bye.
